dataset.name: VeriDoc AI - Synthetic KYC Test Dataset
dataset.disclaimer: ALL DATA IS FICTIONAL. Every image/PDF is watermarked SYNTHETIC / NOT VALID FOR IDENTIFICATION. Identifier values are reserved sentinel patterns that cannot be valid real-world IDs.

conventions.expected_fields: Correct, normalised truth (ISO dates, title-case names).
conventions.rendered_fields: Exact strings printed on the image, incl. deliberate errors. OCR should reproduce these.
conventions.name_comparison: Compare case-insensitively; PAN/Passport/DL print names in UPPERCASE.
